name: Anhui University
supervisors: Anhui Provincial Government (co-built with the Ministry of Education and SASTIND)

evidence.summary: In January 2019 Anhui University announced that the Anhui government and SASTIND had signed an agreement to co-build it, to develop defence-specialty disciplines, defence key discipline laboratories and training for the defence industry and to have it take on military-industry research; its 2023 charter dates the co-construction to 2018.

The university says its capacity to take on defence and military-industry research has grown, with results in military industry, national security and policing technology, and that it has built key disciplines with a distinct defence character.
